profile.headline: Software Engineer | OMSCS @ Georgia Tech | UC Irvine Alumni
profile.summary:
Software engineer with 5+ years of experience in enterprise systems and lab automation.
Pursuing MS in Computer Science at Georgia Tech.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI
positions.description:
- Proposed AI product concepts and owned product development from planning and system architecture through implementation, deployment, and production operations
- Designed application and backend architectures for multi-tenant AI products serving multiple customer organizations
- Developed LLM-based search, matching, and evaluation workflows, and modeled domain knowledge for retrieval and decision-making

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented an on-premise automation platform to orchestrate laboratory workflows across multiple autonomous instruments, integrating vendor interfaces (OPC-UA APIs, COM-based SDKs)
- Redesigned system-wide state management by separating operational state from log data, introducing a cached state model to support reliable unattended execution and real-time visualization across hardware and web dashboards
- Developed installer-based upgrade pipeline with rollback support for air-gapped environments, reducing deployment time by 80%

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained 25+ enterprise systems for Hyundai Motor Group’s $100M+ diagnostic device business, owning full SDLC from architecture design to deployment and operation across the Americas
- Designed and integrated service-to-service communication layers using SOAP, REST, and GraphQL APIs to support cross-platform diagnostic workflows at scale
- Spearheaded POCs and proposed internal tools, improving operational efficiency by up to 80% and reducing AWS RDS costs by 20% through query optimization
- Collaborated effectively with cross-functional teams, clients, and external vendors, ensuring smooth communication and project alignment, and mentored new hires
- Led internal POCs and platform tooling initiatives to automate operational workflows, improving execution efficiency by up to 95% and reducing AWS RDS costs by 20% through query optimization
- Documented all processes and technical decisions to ensure maintainability and knowledge sharing

honors.title: Employee of the Year 2022
honors.issuer: Issued by Yongmin Kim, CEO of the GIT America, Inc. U.S. Corporation (01/2022 ~ 12/2023) · Dec 2022

projects.title: FAQ Chatbot POC
projects.description:
- Developed a real-time knowledge sync and dashboard service for centralized FAQ data management and dashboard
- Built a lightweight, embeddable chatbot UI service for internal platforms to deliver seamless conversational support
- Built with Dify, .NET 8.0 MVC, SQL Server, and OpenAI APIs

projects.title: CR/SR Request Management Tool
projects.description:
- Proposed and developed a centralized web platform for managing ServiceNow CR/SR ticket requests across teams
-  Expanded into a unified operations hub with dashboards, admin tools, email alerts, and service status monitoring
- Built with .NET 8.0 MVC, Bootstrap, and MS SQL
